title: P-Image-Try-On launch reel — six verticals
style_bible: Photoreal fashion retail, clean commercial lighting, shallow depth of field, rich environment bokeh. Single subject one frame unless noted. No laptops, screens, or UI overlays.
garment_bible: Garment reference on white sweep or hanger, color-accurate, label and texture readable, no wrinkle clutter.

cast.voice_prompt: One continuous product story — each line continues the previous chapter. Natural US English, warm retail-tech energy, clear lip sync.

narration.style_prompt: Warm retail storyteller, confident product demo pace, one short chapter per vertical, clear diction

background_music.prompt: Instrumental fashion-tech pop bed, soft four-on-the-floor groove, warm synth pads, modern retail energy, understated background music, no vocals, 100 BPM

scenes.title: Hook — p-image-try-on

person.prompt: Photorealistic woman early thirties South Asian retail presenter, simple white tee and light wash jeans base outfit, entire face visible, medium shot in bright modern studio with soft coral accent wall bokeh, confident smile mouth slightly open mid-word, single person one frame 9:16 vertical.

garments.prompt: Flat-lay cobalt blue structured blazer on white sweep, fabric texture visible, single garment no model, catalog product photography.

scenes.voice_script: Virtual try-on that fits real workflows — ecommerce, catalogs, lookbooks, and UGC — powered by p-image-try-on.
scenes.video_prompt: Camera moves continuously with gentle push-in. She speaks to camera, natural hand gesture, mouth centered.

scenes.title: E-commerce product visualization

person.prompt: Photorealistic woman mid twenties white female ecommerce model, neutral white tee and dark jeans base outfit, full-body catalog pose, soft studio key light on white sweep, single person one frame 9:16 vertical.

garments.prompt: Flat-lay emerald green midi dress on white sweep, hanger shadow subtle, color accurate, single garment product photo.

scenes.narration: Turn any SKU flat-lay into an on-model hero — one person photo, one product shot, one try-on call.
scenes.video_prompt: Slow cinematic push-in, subtle fabric sway on dress hem, soft studio light, no walking.

scenes.title: Virtual fitting room

person.prompt: Photorealistic woman late twenties Latina, casual grey tank base outfit, chest-up mirror selfie framing, soft bedroom window light, warm bokeh, friendly expression mouth open mid-word, single person one frame 9:16 vertical.

garments.prompt: Floral midi dress on wooden hanger, ghost mannequin crop, bright pattern readable, product reference photo.

scenes.voice_script: I uploaded a selfie and the dress from the product page — seconds later I'm seeing the fit before I checkout.
scenes.voice_prompt: Casual shopper UGC, friendly female Kore, clear lip sync, not salesy.
scenes.video_prompt: Handheld micro-sway like phone selfie video. She speaks to mirror, mouth centered.

scenes.title: Wholesale & B2B catalog

person.prompt: Photorealistic man early thirties Black male, simple white crewneck and black chinos base outfit, full-body catalog pose, neutral grey studio backdrop, single person one frame 9:16 vertical, clearly male.

garments.prompt: Flat-lay navy merino crew sweater on white sweep, wholesale catalog product shot, texture visible.

scenes.narration: Buyers see one SKU on every body type your line serves — batch try-on for wholesale linesheets.

scenes.title: Lookbook & campaign generation

person.prompt: Photorealistic woman late twenties East Asian editorial model, minimal black turtleneck base layer, strong three-quarter pose, wind-ready hair, rooftop golden hour sky bokeh, single person one frame 9:16 vertical.

garments.prompt: Long camel wool coat flat-lay on white sweep, luxury campaign product reference, fabric drape visible.

scenes.narration: Season lookbooks without location shoots — dress the talent, animate the frame, ship the campaign.
scenes.video_prompt: Slow arc right, golden hour lens flare subtle, coat fabric micro-movement, editorial cinematic.

scenes.title: UGC ad variations

person.prompt: Photorealistic man mid twenties Middle Eastern male streetwear creator, plain white tee base outfit, chest-up urban alley bokeh background, energetic expression mouth open mid-word, single person one frame 9:16 vertical, clearly male.

garments.prompt: Graphic streetwear hoodie flat-lay on white sweep, bold front print readable, product photo.

scenes.voice_script: Same creator, three drops, three hooks — generate the garment, try it on, film the ad variant in one pipeline.
scenes.voice_prompt: UGC creator energy, casual male Puck, clear lip sync.
scenes.video_prompt: Handheld close framing, subtle sway. He speaks to camera mid-gesture, mouth centered.
